meta.name: image-to-code
meta.description: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping old ones, avoid lazy under-generation, avoid cards-inside-cards-inside-cards UI, and keep the hero clean, spacious, readable, and visible on a small laptop.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将设计图转化为精确的网站代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从设计图生成高质量网页代码
copy.tagline_en: Convert design images into precise website code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate high-quality website code from design images

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先自己生成网站设计图，仔细分析图片中的排版、颜色、间距等细节，然后编写代码，让最终网页尽可能与设计图一致。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 制作视觉重要的网页（如首页、落地页、作品集）时，它会自动先出设计图再写代码。

say.text: 帮我设计一个高端 SaaS 产品的首页，先出图再写代码。
say.note: Claude 会先生成设计图，分析后实现前端。

say.text: 为我的作品集网站生成一个英雄区设计图，然后编码实现。
say.note: Claude 会单独为英雄区生成清晰大图，再写代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first generate its own design images for the website, deeply analyze them for layout, typography, spacing, and colors, then implement the frontend code to match the design as closely as possible.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create visually important web pages such as hero sections, landing pages, or portfolio sites. It will automatically follow an image-first workflow.

say_en.text: Design a premium SaaS landing page, generate images first then code.
say_en.note: Claude will generate design images, analyze them, then implement.

say_en.text: Create a hero section design image for my portfolio, then code it.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a fresh large image for the hero, then code.
